text:
incident-bot: Pager alert (P2) — Quality anomaly detected for model rdx-3-small in eu-west1. 15% increase in bad responses over baseline in the last 5m. Alert ID: A-2791234567 :warning:

sophia (oncall): taking this. starting with traces + recent deploy history.

sophia (oncall): @deploy-bot can you confirm any recent canary or config pushes to rdx-3-small in eu-west1?

deploy-bot: Recent events: 2026-03-15T09:01:12Z deploy rdx-3-small:v12 -> eu-west1 canary (10%). No full rollout. No config changes.

sophia (oncall): ok thanks. alex can you pull the sampling logs and top failure examples?

alex (sre): pulling. initial look: spike in trailing token hallucination on prompts > 350 tokens, ramped up ~09:02. Sampled 200 requests, ~18% off-policy answers.

maya (eng): I see a canary inference binary with a slightly different softmax temp patch in the build metadata around that time. v12 included a temp adjustment for throughput?

sophia (oncall): @maya that sounds like a candidate cause. can you diff the change quickly?

maya (eng): diff gist: ```- default_temp=0.7 + default_temp=0.9``` also a fallback rerank change. Noticed it during code review but thought safe for perf.

liam (pm): if that's true, customer-facing risk. What's current impact — are SLAs affected or is this purely quality?

sophia (oncall): mostly quality, user-facing correctness degradation. Latency fine. No increased error rate.

nina (custops): starting informal customer check for top 3 affected accounts in eu-west1 (acct IDs: C-428, C-992, C-117). Will flag potential degradation.

ops-comm (comms): draft status page and customer email needed. keep it short and clear. we should avoid technical blame.

alex (sre): quick runbook suggestion: 1) pin traffic to rdx-3-small:v11 (previous known-good) 2) rollback canary 3) monitor 30m 4) customer notification if persistent.

maya (eng): I can prepare the rollback and a pinned variant. pinning note: we should pin only eu-west1 canary traffic, not global.

sophia (oncall): do it. create a manual route to v11 for eu-west1 and drop canary to 0%.

maya (eng): executing commands now: ```# pin eu-west1 to v11
rdctl route update --model rdx-3-small --region eu-west1 --pin-version v11
rdctl deploy update --canary rdx-3-small --region eu-west1 --weight 0
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Route change queued. Rollback job id: RB-2791234. Expected propagation ~45s.

incident-bot: Routing propagation complete for region eu-west1, rdx-3-small pinned to v11.

sophia (oncall): monitoring logs and evals. alex keep an eye on roll-forward metrics and token distribution.

alex (sre): initial post-pin sampling (n=100) — bad responses dropped from 18% -> 3%. Looks promising.

ops-comm (comms): draft status page update suggestion: "We detected a quality regression affecting rdx-3-small in eu-west1 caused by a canary change. Traffic was pinned to the previous model version and the issue is mitigated. We're monitoring; no action required from customers right now." Want me to post?

liam (pm): yes please. add expected next updates: "We will confirm stability over the next 60 minutes and follow up if further action is needed."

ops-comm (comms): Draft posted to status page (internal): "Investigating → Identified → Mitigated". I'll schedule an external status blurb.

nina (custops): customer email draft (short): "We're reaching out because some users in eu-west1 may have seen degraded outputs from the rdx-3-small model starting ~09:02 UTC. We've rolled affected traffic back to the previous version and are monitoring. If you see ongoing issues, reply or contact support. Apologies for the disruption." Want approvers?

sophia (oncall): looks good. ops-comm please add a line for customers using pinned model overrides: "If you had pinned rdx-3-small to a custom version, this rollback does not change your pin."

ops-comm (comms): added that line. Nina, can you send to the three affected accounts with high priority?

nina (custops): sending now. will paste delivery receipts in thread.

nina (custops): sent to C-428, C-992; C-117 on hold (we're flagged for account manager outreach first).

maya (eng): post-mitigation checklist: 1) revert temp change in v12 in main branch, 2) add perf vs quality guardrail in CI (regression test with our seeded prompts), 3) consider adding a canary QC step to block softmax changes.

sophia (oncall): +1 to all. assign owners?

maya (eng): I'll revert PR now and open a follow-up: PR-2809 (revert temp bump) and PR-2810 (canary QC).

liam (pm): also update runbook: add a quick section 'if canary causes quality regression' with steps we took and customer comm templates.

ops-comm (comms): internal postmortem blurb for now: "Incident A-2791234567: temporary canary change caused quality regression for rdx-3-small in eu-west1; traffic pinned to v11; customers notified; engineers reverting the change and adding CI guardrails." I'll expand in a postmortem doc.

sophia (oncall): handing off to alex for overnight watch. alex, I'll leave a final note in oncall log.

alex (sre): taking handoff. summary for next oncall: mitigation complete, monitoring ok, pinned to v11, PRs created to revert and add tests (PR-2809/2810). Will escalate if error >5% for 10m or if latency changes.

sophia (oncall): thanks. final: ``/incident close A-2791234567 - mitigated; follow-ups PR-2809, PR-2810; cust-notify sent to two accounts; AM reaching C-117``

incident-bot: Incident A-2791234567 status updated: mitigated -> awaiting follow-up. Paging closed.

ops-comm (comms): I'll circulate the customer-facing email copy and a one-paragraph internal note to eng leads. Anything else?

liam (pm): please include an explicit recommendation re: canary QC — block softmax/temp changes without a quality regression gate.

maya (eng): noted. prepping the gate template now.

alex (sre): logging final sample evidence to S3: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/2791234567/samples.zip

nina (custops): copying the sent emails to the incident ticket. closing my loop after AM confirms C-117 outreach.

ops-comm (comms): thanks all. We'll convert this thread into a brief incident report template for distribution. :white_check_mark:
